title: Pocket Fuel Blue Raspberry Shortfill E-Liquid 50ml
description: Blue Raspberry from Pocket Fuel is an utterly irresistible blend of rich, ruby-red raspberries and the deeply delicious taste of dark, ripe blueberries. The syrupy sweetness of your favourite blue slushy, with an exquisitely smooth finish, Blue Raspberry is an ideal all-day vape for anyone with a sweet tooth. These shortfill bottles contain 50ml of nicotine-free liquid, with 10ml of extra space within the bottle to accommodate your nicotine shot of choice. This allows you to create a liquid with your own desired nicotine strength, and typically adding a 10ml nicotine shot to a 50ml shortfill will give you 60ml of 3mg e-liquid. Once you have added your preferred amount of nicotine, make sure you shake the contents of the shortfill bottle well. We also offer a range of 18mg nicotine-containing e-liquid shots in a variety of VG percentage strengths to ensure you find a perfect match to suit your taste.
